units.source_text: 天色似乎也是知情识趣的，忽然笼罩了暮霞。

en.t: The sky too seemed to understand the mood, and suddenly became veiled in evening haze.

units.source_text: 到了夜里，猛烈地刮起风来。

en.t: By night, a fierce wind began to blow.

units.source_text: 气候十分寒冷，仿佛还是冬天。

en.t: The weather was terribly cold, as if it were still winter.

units.source_text: 风吹熄了灯。

en.t: The wind blew out the lamp.

units.source_text: 虽说“春夜何妨暗”，毕竟不甚自在。

en.t: Though one might say that a spring night may well be dark, still it was not very comfortable.

units.source_text: 然而两人都不肯停止说话。

en.t: Even so, neither of them would stop talking.

units.source_text: 未及畅叙无穷无尽的衷曲，夜色已很深了。

en.t: Before they could fully pour out the endless feelings in their hearts, the night had grown very late.

units.source_text: 匂亲王闻知薰中纳言与大女公子爱情深厚无比，便道：

en.t: When Prince Niou learned how deeply Kaoru, the Middle Counselor, had loved the elder princess, he said:

units.source_text: “喂喂！你虽然如此说，但你和她的关系总不止如此而已吧。”

en.t: Come now! You may say that, but surely your relationship with her was not limited to only that.

units.source_text: 他疑心薰中纳言还有隐情未曾说出，想探问出来。

en.t: He suspected that Kaoru still had some hidden matter left unsaid, and tried to draw it out of him.

units.source_text: 这真是以小人之心度君子之腹了。

en.t: This was truly judging a noble heart by the measure of a petty one.

units.source_text: 但匂亲王是知情识趣之人，他一面安慰他，一面又同情他的苦痛，对他说各种各样的话，直说得他的哀愁消散。

en.t: But Prince Niou was a man of tact and feeling; he comforted him, sympathized with his pain, and spoke to him in many ways until his sorrow began to lift.

units.source_text: 薰中纳言被他的花言巧语所哄骗，终于把郁结在心中而实在忍受不住的苦情稍稍发泄，便觉胸次顿时开朗了。

en.t: Won over by his skillful words, Kaoru at last let out a little of the unbearable grief pent up in his heart, and immediately felt his chest grow lighter.

units.source_text: 匂亲王也同他商量二女公子迁居京都之事，薰中纳言说：

en.t: Prince Niou also consulted him about moving the second princess to Kyoto, and Kaoru said:

units.source_text: “若能如此，实甚可喜！

en.t: If that can be done, it would be most welcome!

units.source_text: 不然彼此都很痛苦，连我也觉得自己有过失。

en.t: Otherwise both sides will suffer, and even I feel as though I am at fault.

units.source_text: 我要寻求我所永不忘怀的那人的遗爱，除了这人以外更有谁呢？

en.t: If I seek the living keepsake of the one I can never forget, who could it be but this person?

units.source_text: 故关于此人日常一切生活，我自认是保护人。

en.t: Therefore, in all matters of her daily life, I regard myself as her guardian.

units.source_text: 但不知你是否会猜疑耳。”

en.t: I only do not know whether you will suspect my motives.

units.source_text: 便把大女公子生前荐妹自代、请他勿视妹为外人之意，略略向他说明。

en.t: He then briefly explained that before her death the elder princess had commended her younger sister to him in her place, asking him not to regard the girl as an outsider.

units.source_text: 但关于“岩濑森林内郭公”似的那一夜对面共话之事，则秘而不宣。

en.t: But he kept secret the matter of that night when they had spoken face to face, like the cuckoo in the forest of Iwase.

units.source_text: 只是心中寻思：“我如此思念大女公子，无以自慰，她的遗爱只此一人。

en.t: He merely thought to himself: I miss the elder princess so deeply and have no comfort; this person alone is what she left behind.

units.source_text: 我正该像匂亲王一般当她的保护人才好。”

en.t: I ought to have become her guardian, just as Prince Niou has done.

units.source_text: 他越发后悔了。

en.t: He regretted it all the more.

units.source_text: 然而又想：“如今后悔莫及。

en.t: Yet he also thought: Regret is useless now.

units.source_text: 常常如此想念她，深恐发生荒谬的恋情，为人为己两皆不利，岂不愚哉！”

en.t: If I keep thinking of her like this, I fear some absurd love may arise, harmful both to others and to myself; how foolish that would be!

units.source_text: 便断绝了念头。

en.t: So he cut off that thought.

units.source_text: 又想：“虽然如此，她迁居京都以后，真能照拂她的，除我而外更有何人？”

en.t: Then he thought again: Even so, after she moves to Kyoto, who besides me can truly look after her?

units.source_text: 就帮助匂亲王准备迁居之事。

en.t: He therefore helped Prince Niou prepare for her move.
